answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 5746 Country: India Title: We are civil, interior and painting contractors. my question is can we take the renovation contract of dargah & its mazhaar? Question: We are civil, interior and painting contractors. my question is can we take the renovation contract of dargah & its mazhaar? Answer ID: 5746 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 555/519=L/1429) It is not right to take renovation contract of dargah or mazar . The Messenger of Allah ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) prohibited erecting building on graves: واما البناء علیہ فلم ار من اختار جوازہ و فی شرح المنیۃ عن منیۃ المفتی: و عن ابی حنیفۃ یکرہ ان یبنی علیہ بناء من بیت او قبۃ او نحو ذلک لما روی جابر: نھی رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم عن تجصیص القبور وان یکتب علیھا و ان یبنی علیھا۔ ( شامی: 3/144 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
